title: Infernux v0.4.3-v8 · Hotfix 8: Camera Rendering and Hub Windows
codename: Hotfix 8: Camera Rendering and Hub Windows
summary: This hotfix adopts reversed-Z depth rendering, isolates camera state between render views, and fixes custom skies, directional shadows and Hub window behavior. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 8, with Hub 0.4.3-9.

items.title: Use reversed-Z for scene depth, with matching projection, clear values, depth comparisons, picking and depth-dependent rendering on Vulkan and WebGPU.
items.text: Use reversed-Z for scene depth, with matching projection, clear values, depth comparisons, picking and depth-dependent rendering on Vulkan and WebGPU.

items.title: Keep camera globals, clipping planes and projection settings local to each Game, Scene and preview render view. Add an editable camera dither option.
items.text: Keep camera globals, clipping planes and projection settings local to each Game, Scene and preview render view. Add an editable camera dither option.

items.title: Preserve the existing World UI policy: UI configured to face the camera continues to face the Game camera, including when viewed from the Scene panel.
items.text: Preserve the existing World UI policy: UI configured to face the camera continues to face the Game camera, including when viewed from the Scene panel.

items.title: Correct directional shadow depth so rotating the viewing camera does not change the physical size of a stationary object's shadow.
items.text: Correct directional shadow depth so rotating the viewing camera does not change the physical size of a stationary object's shadow.

items.title: Repair custom panoramic sky rendering and its asset dependencies, with sky background depth aligned to reversed-Z.
items.text: Repair custom panoramic sky rendering and its asset dependencies, with sky background depth aligned to reversed-Z.

items.title: Keep keyboard input inside the focused Game panel, preventing Tab from selecting editor controls during gameplay. Retain Scene camera mouse movement across GUI updates.
items.text: Keep keyboard input inside the focused Game panel, preventing Tab from selecting editor controls during gameplay. Retain Scene camera mouse movement across GUI updates.

items.title: Allow completed animation states to respond to later transitions, and improve animation node graph readability.
items.text: Allow completed animation states to respond to later transitions, and improve animation node graph readability.

items.title: Publish coherent hierarchy transforms in batch operations and reject batches bound to a different world before applying changes.
items.text: Publish coherent hierarchy transforms in batch operations and reject batches bound to a different world before applying changes.

items.title: Keep hot-reload candidate importers alive through durable publication and preserve recoverable editor transaction rollback state.
items.text: Keep hot-reload candidate importers alive through durable publication and preserve recoverable editor transaction rollback state.

items.title: Confine package extraction to its destination and publish decoded entries atomically, including packages with search-only directory permissions on Linux.
items.text: Confine package extraction to its destination and publish decoded entries atomically, including packages with search-only directory permissions on Linux.

items.title: Compare fixed-update timing samples individually in tests, preserving both clock checks and numerical precision under pytest 9.2.
items.text: Compare fixed-update timing samples individually in tests, preserving both clock checks and numerical precision under pytest 9.2.

items.title: Prevent labels, buttons and installation progress controls from appearing as temporary standalone windows while refreshing project cards, opening dialogs or displaying installation jobs.
items.text: Prevent labels, buttons and installation progress controls from appearing as temporary standalone windows while refreshing project cards, opening dialogs or displaying installation jobs.

items.title: Remove global always-on-top behavior from the editor startup splash while retaining its loading progress and appearance.
items.text: Remove global always-on-top behavior from the editor startup splash while retaining its loading progress and appearance.

items.title: Rebuild platform Player packages against the new engine release and publish new Windows and Linux wheels, Hub installers and Hub update archives.
items.text: Rebuild platform Player packages against the new engine release and publish new Windows and Linux wheels, Hub installers and Hub update archives.
